mapper.select: SELECT owner_id FROM kb_knowledge_base WHERE id = #{kbId}

SELECT d.id AS id, d.kb_id AS "kbId", d.name AS name, d.file_type AS "fileType", d.file_size AS "fileSize", d.char_count AS "charCount", d.chunk_count AS "chunkCount", d.status AS status, d.error_msg AS "errorMsg", d.created_at AS "createdAt", d.updated_at AS "updatedAt", CASE WHEN d.status = 'READY' THEN 100 WHEN d.status = 'FAILED' THEN 0 WHEN COALESCE(c.total_chunks, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE LEAST(99, (c.embedded_chunks * 100 / c.total_chunks)::int) END AS progress FROM kb_document d LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) AS total_chunks, count(*) FILTER (WHERE embedding IS NOT NULL) AS embedded_chunks FROM kb_chunk WHERE kb_id = d.kb_id AND document_id = d.id ) c ON true WHERE d.kb_id = #{kbId} AND d.name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' AND d.status = #{status} ORDER BY d.created_at DESC, d.id DESC

SELECT k.id AS id, k.name AS name, k.description AS description, k.embedding_model_id AS "embeddingModelId", em.name AS "embeddingModelName", k.rerank_model_id AS "rerankModelId", k.rerank_enabled AS "rerankEnabled", k.retrieval_mode AS "retrievalMode", k.top_k AS "topK", k.score_threshold AS "scoreThreshold", k.vector_weight AS "vectorWeight", k.bm25_weight AS "bm25Weight", k.chunk_size AS "chunkSize", k.chunk_overlap AS "chunkOverlap", k.owner_id AS "ownerId", u.username AS "ownerName", k.visibility AS visibility, k.status AS status, k.doc_count AS "docCount", k.chunk_count AS "chunkCount", k.created_at AS "createdAt", k.updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM kb_knowledge_base k LEFT JOIN llm_model em ON em.id = k.embedding_model_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = k.owner_id WHERE k.id = #{kbId}
